svg.title: One-demonstration bimanual manipulation
svg.desc: Analytical pretraining fits the manipulation PFN. A three-object demonstration and a current scene table predict only two synchronized sequences of wrist poses using observed poses and entity semantics. An image-conditioned ACT or GR00T policy executes a short action prefix and observes the scene again.
svg.text: A demonstration of 3D entity motion guides two wrist trajectories in a new scene.
Generate paired tables from two factors
Left push, right push, carry, handover.
Both grippers appear in every scene.
Vary entity count and layout across episodes.
Complete two columns over a future window
Each entity and goal cell stores a pose (p, q) with 3D position and unit quaternion in a shared frame.
Column headers carry semantics such as gripper side, object category, colour, shape and size.
Shared clock · H poses per arm
Ground the pose waypoints in vision
with pose refinement and grip control.
Observe both grippers and objects, then query again.
Target-task evaluation uses one three-object demonstration and fresh scenes with different object counts.
